'''Resources Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It was the second largest division and had two responsibilities; search for new supplies of raw materials, as well as design and procure all equipment for the Authority. Subdivisions included [[Scout Services]], [[Central Services]], and [[Supplies and Allocation]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
